lines.en: I pace back and forth on the stone steps.

lines.zh: 走到柱子边上，我又折回来。
lines.en: I reach the pillar and turn back.

lines.zh: 我不走远，就守着这座殿。
lines.en: I don't wander far; I keep to this hall.

lines.zh: 袍子扫过地砖，声音很轻。
lines.en: My robe whispers over the tiles.

lines.zh: 我去看了看供桌，又回原位。
lines.en: I check the altar, then return to my place.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，脚下的影跟着走。
lines.en: Step by step, my shadow follows.

lines.zh: 有风从殿门进来，我迎了一下。
lines.en: Wind enters the hall and I turn to meet it.

lines.zh: 我走过廊下，数着剩下的格子。
lines.en: I walk the corridor counting the remaining tiles.

lines.zh: 我把手背在身后，慢慢巡。
lines.en: Hands behind my back, I make a slow round.

lines.zh: 我走到门口，看看有没有人来。
lines.en: I walk to the door and check if anyone comes.

lines.zh: 绕过大殿一圈，正好一圈。
lines.en: One full circuit of the hall. Exactly one.

lines.zh: 我停在碑前，站了一会儿又走。
lines.en: I stop at the stele, then walk on.
I never hurry; there's no rushing this.

lines.zh: 地上有块松砖，我绕着它。
lines.en: A loose tile; I walk around it.
I smooth my sleeves and wait.

lines.zh: 这天色，怕是不会有人来。
lines.en: By this light, likely no one will come.

lines.zh: 我把手里的卷轴换了只手。
lines.en: I move the scroll to my other hand.
The hall is quiet. Good for thinking.
Ask if you're unsure; I'm here.
Over the years I've waited for many.

lines.zh: 我咳嗽一声，清了清嗓子。
lines.en: I cough once to clear my throat.
I brush the dust from the table.
I remember everyone who has come.

lines.zh: 门外那棵树又落了几片。
lines.en: A few more leaves fell from the tree outside.

lines.zh: 我不催你，你想清楚再说。
lines.en: I won't hurry you; think it through.
The wick's grown short. I should trim it.
You may sit and rest a while.

lines.zh: 你终于来了，我等你很久。
lines.en: You've come at last. I've waited long.
Come closer. I don't bite.

lines.zh: 你这身打扮，不像是神殿的人。
lines.en: Dressed like that, you are no temple regular.
Speak up; don't just stand there.
I sense a little ki about you.
There's something you want to learn in your eyes.
The road is still long for the young.

lines.zh: 你不必紧张，这里不打人。
lines.en: Don't be tense; no one fights here.

lines.zh: 你想知道什么？挑要紧的。
lines.en: What do you want to know? Pick what matters.

lines.zh: 我认得那种眼神，是在犹豫。
lines.en: I know that look. You're hesitating.
The echo in this hall is fine.
Hold out your hand and let me see.
Which mountain do you come from?
Don't rush off. Sit and talk.

lines.zh: 我这一生，见过不少来客。
lines.en: In my life I've seen many visitors.

lines.zh: 你要问的，我大概猜到了。
lines.en: I can guess what you're about to ask.
There was no need to strike.
I steady myself on the pillar.
I step back twice and catch my breath.
Striking an old man isn't decent.
My robe is torn.
I cough twice and wave it off.
I won't hold it against you.
There should be no blood in this hall.
Hit me again and I'll leave.
Whatever you bring, I won't take it.
I've eaten. Thank you.

lines.zh: 你要是想送礼，先说说事。
lines.en: If you're offering a gift, state your business first.
We're not short of such things here.
Keep it for the road.
I accept the courtesy, not the goods.
Those who train don't indulge the belly.
Trying to please me? Unnecessary.
Careful; the tiles are slick.
Steady yourself, then speak.
Are you hurt?
Let's both step aside and go on.
I steady myself on the pillar.
In such a hurry — where to?
The hall is spacious; no need to crowd.

lines.zh: 小心点，我只是个传话的。
lines.en: Careful — I only carry messages.
Another elder is in the hall too.

lines.zh: 我们点了点头，没有多话。
lines.en: We nod to each other, no words needed.
He came decades before me.
We keep the two doors between us.
Between colleagues, one sentence suffices.
I push the tea toward him.
He finishes a thought, and I continue it.
Together we've watched several generations.
Night deepens; we return to our posts.
We'll meet here again tomorrow.

lines.zh: 这是谁掉的？我替你收着。
lines.en: Whose is this? I'll hold it for you.
I bend, pick it up, and pat it clean.
Keep your things safe; don't lose them.
This pearl — did you drop it?
I put it in a drawer for its owner.

lines.zh: 捡到东西，总会有人来找。
lines.en: Someone always comes looking for what they lost.

lines.zh: 这些散落的，我顺手收了。
lines.en: I gather up these scattered bits.

lines.zh: 你手上东西多，我帮你拿。
lines.en: Your hands are full; let me carry that.
Don't panic; nothing is lost.
Someone's come. Let me look.
There's movement over there. I'm watching.
I won't strike; I'm only watching.
Who's making that racket?

lines.zh: 我提了提袍子，往那边走。
lines.en: I lift my robe and head that way.
I should keep an eye on this area.
First I'll find out who it is.
Don't make trouble at my hall's door.
I note that direction.

lines.zh: 有客人还是有不速之客？
lines.en: A guest, or an intruder?
I follow two steps, then stop.
He went east. Noted.
No need to shout; it wouldn't help.
I watch from the doorway, not interfering.
That one's aura is strong. Best left alone.
I'll report this to the elder.
If it turns, then I'll act.
I close the door halfway.
The rules of this hall must hold.
I raise a hand for the others to stand back.
I don't strike people; I only counsel.
Stop! No fighting here.
I raise a hand between you.
Cause more trouble and I'll call for help.
I keep my strength for sweeping.

lines.zh: 我推了你一把，是想让你冷静。
lines.en: I pushed you to cool you down.
Fists solve nothing.
If you must fight, do it outside.
I bar you at the door.

lines.zh: 我只是挡了一下，没还手。
lines.en: I only blocked. I didn't strike back.

lines.zh: 我在这殿里，等了很多年。
lines.en: I've been in this hall for many years.
You've come, so I speak.

lines.zh: 这地方从我记事起就在。
lines.en: This place has stood since before my memory.
I straighten my collar and stand tall.
A new face again. Welcome.
I go nowhere; I stay here.

lines.zh: 有人把这座殿修得很好。
lines.en: Someone has kept this hall well.
I'm right here, sparing you the search.
The lamp still burns; that means I'm here.
Ask what you need while I'm here.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的袖子，我赶紧拍。
lines.en: Fire catches my sleeve; I slap it out.
That fall left my legs weak.

lines.zh: 水没到我胸口，我被人拉住了。
lines.en: Water reaches my chest; someone holds me up.
Dust from the ceiling covers me.

lines.zh: 箭头落在离我一步的地方。
lines.en: The arrow lands a step from me.
A flash of light dazzles me.
I've eaten little during these days of fasting.

lines.zh: 雷声把我手里的卷轴震掉了。
lines.en: Thunder knocks the scroll from my hand.

lines.zh: 我脚下空了，抓不住东西。
lines.en: The floor is gone; I grasp at nothing.
